run_overlap_filter: run the script to filter point cloud pairs with overlap >= 0.3 from overlap.txt files
generate_overlap30_list: generate an overlap30.txt file containing point cloud pairs with overlap score of at least 0.3
filter_pcd_pairs: filter point cloud pairs by overlap threshold across all subdirectories in the target directory
run_scannet_pair_generator: run the ScanNet pair generation script with --target_dir pointing to the data directory
aggregate_overlap_files: aggregate overlap data from all per-scene overlap.txt files into a single filtered output file
